claim.statement: Over every characteristic-zero field k, in C=k[a,d,b,c,u]/(ac-bd-1), every fiber-weight-preserving locally nilpotent k-derivation D with D(W+a^2u^2-d^2)=0 is zero whenever all actual auxiliary components of W above degree 1 vanish.
hypotheses: k is a field of characteristic zero
C is the displayed determinant-one quotient
D is a k-derivation locally nilpotent on every element
D preserves each actual fiber-weight space
W has no auxiliary component in a degree greater than 1
not_assumed: a polynomial representative for the vertical coefficient q

verdict_scope: The stated local algebraic rigidity theorem, including arbitrary W and arbitrary integer leading shift.

attribution.assessed_work: Old Argus engineering draft Theorem 2 and IndependentStableCore.lower_perturbation_rigidity, reusing OAI helper proofs
attribution.comparison: OpenAI, A stable coordinate that is not a coordinate in four variables, October 5, 2026, prop:rigidity
attribution.source_verified_difference: The cited proposition only fixes a^3b+a^2u^2-d^2. The assessed theorem replaces a^3b by any W with auxiliary components at most 1, using the same leading-component mechanism.
attribution.classification: Strengthening relative to the inspected October statement; no global originality claim

components.reason: The primitive linear determinant polynomial is prime over the field-based polynomial UFD. Its ideal is homogeneous for both rows, and coefficientwise projections commute after quotienting.
Finite generator supports give an attained maximum m, all higher derivation components vanish globally, and proj_(e+nm)(D^n r)=D_m^n r holds for every integer m.
The actual DegreeLE map bound gives degree(DW)<=m+1, so projection at m+2 isolates D_m(a^2u^2-d^2); no fiber homogeneity of W is used.
Characteristic-zero domain factorial closure applies to the two nonzero difference-of-squares factors and to a*u; actual determinant-point evaluations prove the required nonvanishing.

q=cD_m(b)-bD_m(c) is initially in C. Localization at invariant denominators and the one-variable LND theorem make q constant in both independent coefficient charts; relatively prime power denominators then place q in k[a,d,u].
q has actual fiber weight -2 while the polynomial base image has only nonnegative weight support. Directness forces q=0 and hence D_m=0.
The inspected declaration encodes all W satisfying the actual quotient degree bound over every characteristic-zero field.
This declaration alone does not construct an embedding, lift an arbitrary base LND, or make a four-variable polynomial noncoordinate for every perturbation.
Only the precise strengthening relative to the source-verified October proposition was established.
